collocations: a small Hindu temple：一座小的印度教寺庙
temple of heaven：天坛
temple fair：庙会
words.etymology: “building for worship, edifice dedicated to the service of a deity or deities,” Old English tempel, from Latin templum “piece of ground consecrated for the taking of auspices, building for worship of a god,” of uncertain signification. 来自拉丁文templum，原指“古罗马人用手或魔 杖在天空或地面划出来用来占卜的区域”。后来temple指敬拜神灵的 场所，即矗立在神圣的区域内的神殿、寺庙。
words.mnemonic: tem-（保留、划分的区域）+ -ple→用于敬拜的神圣区域→神殿；寺庙

collocations: contemplate a career as an army medical doctor：考虑做一名军医
contemplate his future：考虑他的未来
contemplate his hands：凝视着他的双手
words.mnemonic:
con-（强调前缀）+ templ（=temple：寺庙，沉思默想之地）+ -ate
（动词后缀）→（花时间精力）进行沉思；凝视

collocations: a place of quiet contemplation：一个适合静静深思的地方
be lost in the contemplation of the landscape：沉湎在对风景的凝视中
a quiet, contemplative sort of child：一个安静沉思型孩子
words.mnemonic: contemplate（考虑；沉思）+ -ive（形容词后缀）→沉思的；默想的

collocations: trace around your template：沿着模板描摹
layout templates：设计模板
words.definition: （用于切割木材、纸、金属等的）模板；（计算
words.mnemonic: tem-（切；划分）+ plate（金属的板条，板材）→切割板条、板材→

collocations: a course in anatomy：一门解剖学课程
an anatomy of the current recession：对当前经济衰退的剖析
words.definition: （动植物的）结构，解剖；人体；剖析，解析
words.etymology: 14世纪晚期，含义为“study or knowledge of the structure and function of the human body”。
words.mnemonic: ana-（=up）+ -tomy（=to cut：切）→a cutting up：切开→结构；解

collocations: minute anatomical differences between insects：昆虫之间微小的身体结
words.mnemonic: anatom（anatomy：人体；结构）+ -ical（形容词后缀）→身体结构的

collocations: the splitting of the atom：原子的分裂
words.mnemonic: a-（=not：不）+ -tom（a cutting）→不能再分割的物质→原子

collocations: atomic structure：原子结构
atomic energy / power：原子能 / 动力
the atomic bomb：原子弹
words.definition: 原子的；原子能的；原子武器的
words.mnemonic: atom（原子）+ -ic（形容词后缀）→原子的；原子能的

collocations: dichotomy between A and B：一分为二；二分法
examples:
There is a dichotomy between the academic world and the industrial world.
学术界和工业界间有天壤之别。
words.mnemonic:
dicho-（=in two：二个，来自di-的希腊语形式）+ -tomy（=a cutting：
切）→a cutting in two：即切成两半的，分成两个级别的→二分法；

words.definition: 叉状分枝的；分成两个的

collocations: clothes that are the epitome of good taste：典型的高品味服装
the epitome of sophistication：老于世故的典型
words.mnemonic: epi-（=among：从里面）+ -tome（=to cut：切）→从里面切出来→

examples:
The fighting qualities of the team are epitomized by the captain.
这个队的战斗精神从队长身上体现出来。
words.mnemonic:
epitom（=epitomy：典型）+ -ize（动词后缀，使……）→typify,
embody：成为……的典范（或典型）

words.definition: （尤指理论性的）大部头书；巨著
words.etymology: c. 1300, “extent or area; room” (to do something), a shortening of Old French espace “period of time, distance, interval” (12c.), from Latin spatium “room, area, distance, stretch of time,” a word of unknown origin (also source of Spanish espacio, Italian spazio).

collocations: plenty of space：足够的空间

launch satellites into space：发射人造卫星到外层空间
evenly spaced plants：间隔均匀的秧苗
space sth. out：使拉开间距；使隔开
words.definition: 空间，间隔；场所；一段（时间）；余地；太空 vt.

collocations: a spacious kitchen：一个宽敞的厨房
words.mnemonic:
spac（=space：空间）+ -ious（形容词后缀，表示充分的）→空间充
分的→宽敞的

spatial awareness：空间意识

words.mnemonic: spa（=space：空间）+ t +-ial（形容词后缀）→空间的；感悟空间的

collocations: locate them spatially：放在空间的不同位置

manned spaceship：载人宇宙飞船

aero-（=atmosphere：大气）+ space（外太空）→大气层之外的外太
空领域的→航空航天

collocations: secure cyberspace：安全网络
words.mnemonic: cyber（网络的）+ space（空间）→网络空间
